title: Drug Mechanism of Action RNA-seq
description: Differential expression and gene set enrichment analysis to elucidate drug mechanism of action from RNA-seq count data.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

treated_counts.description: TSV count matrix (genes × treated samples). Rows = genes, columns = treated replicates.

target_gene.description: Primary target gene or pathway for enrichment annotation.

gmt_file.description: Gene set GMT file (MSigDB format). Falls back to gseapy built-in Hallmarks if not provided.

n_replicates.description: Expected number of replicates per condition (for QC warnings).

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
